# tandoor_api

Dart client for the Tandoor Recipes API, generated by
[openapi-generator](https://openapi-generator.tech) (`dart-dio`, built_value serialization) from the schema of the
Tandoor version pinned in `/TANDOOR_VERSION`.

**Do not edit `lib/`.** Regenerate it instead (see `CLAUDE.md`, "Bumping the Tandoor version"):

```sh
dart run tool/fetch_schema.dart    # local Tandoor → schema/openapi-<version>.json
dart run tool/generate_api.dart    # schema → lib/ (Docker, build_runner, dart format)
```

Only `lib/data/` in the app imports this package; DTOs are mapped to domain models in `lib/data/mappers/`.

## What to expect from the generated types

- **Every `id` is nullable.** Tandoor's schema post-processing hook (`cookbook/helper/drf_spectacular_hooks.py`)
  makes every `id` optional and writable so nested writes work. The mappers turn ids into non-null values on domain
  models.
- **Every read-only field is nullable.** The schema declares read-only fields required and non-null, but Tandoor sends
  `null` for many of them and omits some. `tool/generate_api.dart` makes them optional before generating; the
  committed schema is unchanged. Details in `docs/TANDOOR_API.md#schema`.
- **Enums have an `unknownDefaultOpenApi` value** for values a newer Tandoor adds.
- Lists are `BuiltList`, objects are built with builders: `CookLog((b) => b..recipe = 42..servings = 2)`.

## Usage

```dart
final api = TandoorApi(basePathOverride: 'https://recipes.example.com')
  ..setApiKey('ApiKeyAuth', 'Bearer $token'); // the schema models the header as an API key
final settings = await api.getApiApi().apiServerSettingsCurrentRetrieve();
```

All endpoints are on `ApiApi` (`api.getApiApi()`), except `POST /api-token-auth/` on `ApiTokenAuthApi`.
